title: Gate-list emission
statement: Let $z$ be a natural number, let $gs$ be a finite list of Boolean-circuit gates, and suppose every gate in $gs$ has at most two arguments. For every Boolean list $r$, starting the emitter in phase $g$ with vertex counter $z$ and both argument counters zero, then reading the encoded list $gs$ followed by $r$, produces the serialization of the clauses obtained by concatenating the gates’ Tseitin formulas at successive output indices starting from $z$, followed by a false bit.
hypotheses_covered: Each gate in $gs$ has at most two arguments
